cases.name: grug
cases.lesson: A focused idea, playful bespoke visual language, and deliberate omission of unnecessary account/cloud complexity can create a memorable product.

cases.name: Guitar Wiz
cases.lesson: Strong VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Increased Contrast and Differentiate Without Color can be part of the core design rather than afterthoughts.

cases.name: Structured
cases.lesson: A simple, highly scannable layout can make planning more approachable, especially when automation reduces input burden.

cases.name: NBA: Live Games & Scores
cases.lesson: Platform-specific design can present simultaneous spatial content and contextual stats without treating spatial UI as a flat screen.

cases.name: Moonlitt: Moon Phase Tracker
cases.lesson: Cross-platform consistency plus strong Liquid Glass integration and easy onboarding can keep a specialized utility intuitive.

cases.name: Tide Guide: Charts & Tables
cases.lesson: Dense environmental data can remain clear through strong charts, custom animation, contextual color and polished Liquid Glass.

cases.name: Primary: News in Depth
cases.lesson: A minimal interface can intentionally recede so content remains the focus, especially for information-heavy experiences.

cases.name: Sago Mini Jinja’s Garden
cases.lesson: Interfaces can be intuitive without reading when controls map directly to natural gestures and visible affordances.

cases.name: (Not Boring) Camera
cases.lesson: Bold personality can coexist with professional functionality when tactile controls, haptics and visual hierarchy stay coherent.

cases.name: The Outsiders: Athlete Tracker
cases.lesson: Complex health and training metrics become understandable through a clear primary visualization and restrained supporting data.
